description: PAID: store a file (bytes as base64) for the plan term; the paying wallet owns it. Returns its id and expiry. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

contentBase64.description: The bytes to store, base64-encoded. Decoded size must fit the plan.

label.description: Optional caller-chosen label, up to 256 characters, no control characters.

plan.description: Storage plan; it sets both the size limit and the price. See GET /pricing or the service_card tool for the live table.

name: storage_buy
title: Store an object (paid, x402)
